scope: Storage failure containment in one loaded API instance. Pure VM and synthetic Storage/transport only.
behavior: Mark the credential pair untrusted before any save, rotation or clear mutation; any getItem/setItem/removeItem failure or mismatched readback leaves it blocked.

Authenticated JSON, PDF, logo, export, logout and refresh reject with stable code session_storage_error while untrusted. Mixed refresh queues settle and cannot install an old pair after a partial explicit save.
A complete explicit saveTokens or clearTokens with verified readback recovers trust. Re-reading a pair, a storage event, or an old refresh cannot recover trust.
No rollback or compensating credential writes. A newer complete explicit recovery wins over an older synchronous attempt.
Messages are localized and do not include stored values or the original Storage diagnostic. The exception may remain as cause; standard Storage exception names are preserved.
limits: The pair remains in two legacy localStorage keys, including direct writers outside Api. No total atomicity, durable trust after reload, or interleaved cross-tab writer guarantee is claimed.
No real browser quota exhaustion, JWT/backend/RBAC acceptance, runtime26 or HTTP/browser validation is represented by this lot. R10 remains open.
No app/server restart, browser run, backend/model/CI modification, external provider, email or network was performed for this follow-up.
